name: podcast-loudness-normalizer
title: Podcast Loudness Normalizer (LUFS, True Peak) for AI Agents
description: Normalize podcast, voice or video audio to -16 LUFS (Apple/podcast), -14 LUFS (Spotify/YouTube), -23 LUFS (EBU R128) or a custom target with a true-peak ceiling, using two-pass FFmpeg loudnorm. Returns the file plus before/after LUFS, LRA and true peak.
